ability.name: Acorn of the Ages
ability.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** wholly within 12" of this unit, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all enemy units and other terrain features.

ability.name: Ranu's Lamentiri
ability.effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

ability.name: Glamourweave
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
